description: Check one agent vendor's public identity, website risk, discovery readiness, and optional payment or proof-requirement surfaces in one bounded report. The service never sends credentials, proofs, payments, signatures, approvals, or transactions. Price: 0.05 USDC. Mode: live_source. Source: DNS, RDAP.org, live TLS and public website metadata, OFAC, GLEIF, public agent-discovery files, and optional public x402 or x401 endpoint probes. Set auto_pay=true for a one-call purchase when the local buyer wallet is configured.

auto_pay.description: Automatically authorize and pay this request with the locally configured buyer wallet. Requires X402_AUTO_PAY=true and X402_EVM_PRIVATE_KEY.

organization.description: Optional legal or trading name for sanctions and legal-entity screening.

paid_endpoint.description: Optional public x402 endpoint to inspect without paying.

paid_method.description: GET, HEAD, or POST for the optional x402 probe. Defaults to GET.

payment_id.description: payment_id returned by the x402 invoice.

payment_signature.description: Base64 x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE produced by a compatible buyer client.

preview.description: Inspect a rate-limited live contract proof showing source, freshness, response shape, and required inputs. Decision-ready values remain in the paid result.

proof_method.description: GET or HEAD for the optional x401 probe. Defaults to GET.

proof_url.description: Optional public x401 proof-requirement endpoint to inspect without sending a proof.

tx_hash.description: Base transaction hash after paying an x402 invoice.

name: agent_vendor_trust_check
